scope: NiFe_HyhNADPH__SHI_beta cofactor compatibility only; no query cluster occupancy, NADPH specificity, expression, or activity inference.

primary_sources.local_review_source_sha256: recorded in config/reference_domain_policy.json; exact-sequence structure mapping is retained there

reference_identity.structure_entity: 9NEZ entity 2, author chain B; symmetry mate chain F
reference_identity.mapping: The local reviewed UniProt sequence is 367 aa and exactly matches the deposited 9NEZ entity-2 sequence mapping (100% identity and full coverage in config/reference_structure_review.json).

coordinate_contact_audit.method: Read _struct_conn metalc records in the deposited CIF; accept only explicit SG-to-SF4 iron contacts and record deposited distances.

additional_non_cysteine_contact.interpretation: Explicit deposited metal contact; retain as a possible non-Cys/His relay-ligand feature, not as a reason to replace the four Cys ligands of that cluster.

coordinate_contact_audit.symmetry_check: Chain F contains the corresponding duplicated entity-2 contacts with the same residue numbers; chain B is used for the primary report.
coordinate_contact_audit.contact_quality: All 16 Cys-SF4-Fe contacts are 2.252-2.284 A and explicitly deposited as metalc connections, so they are not borderline ~3.0 A proximity-only contacts. H94-ND1 is 2.126 A and also explicitly deposited.

hypothesis_check.result: The proposed 12 are real deposited ligands, but they are incomplete for entity 2: CIF metalc records also assign C246, C248, C271, and C299 to SF4_404.
hypothesis_check.important_discrepancy: The primary-paper abstract describes SHI-beta as containing three [4Fe-4S] clusters, whereas the deposited 9NEZ entity-2 chain-B CIF contains four SF4 groups with explicit chain-B Cys contacts. Preserve this as a source/structure discrepancy; do not silently delete the fourth coordinate-supported cluster or convert it into an activity claim.
hypothesis_check.safe_reviewed_set: For coordinate compatibility, retain all 16 Cys contacts grouped into SF4_401/402/403/404, plus H94 as an explicitly deposited additional contact. A three-cluster functional interpretation remains a paper-level statement requiring reconciliation, not a sequence-only rule.

hyd3_msmeg3931_comparison.reported_comparison: Hyd3 from Mycobacterium smegmatis MSMEG3931: 26.97% identity, E-value 7e-32, 17/18 reviewed Cys positions covered, 15 preserved; C191->T, C299->H, and C343 uncovered in the comparison supplied for this audit.
loss_or_uncertainty: C191 is not an SF4 metal ligand in the deposited SHI-beta chain; it forms a disulfide with C343 across the symmetry-related chain and is therefore not counted as an Fe-S ligand.
C299 is a deposited SF4_404 ligand; a C299->H substitution is a direct loss of the canonical Cys-SF4 contact and should be reported as a cofactor-compatibility concern, not as proof of inactivity.
C343 is a deposited inter-chain disulfide partner of C191, not an SF4 ligand; being uncovered does not by itself remove the Fe-S relay set.
hyd3_msmeg3931_comparison.interpretation: The comparison supports a conservative relay-fold/cofactor-compatibility statement only. It does not justify accepting a sequence with C299H as fully equivalent, nor rejecting it as categorically inactive without a structure or biochemical test.

minimal_role_compatibility.supported: A query retaining the aligned 16 deposited Cys-SF4 contact positions (with the H94 contextual contact treated separately) is compatible with the reviewed SHI-beta Fe-S relay architecture.
minimal_role_compatibility.partial: Loss or substitution of one documented Cys, especially C299, should yield partial/uncertain Fe-S relay compatibility with an explicit missing-ligand risk; do not block all hydrogenase identity solely from this module result.
not_inferred: cluster occupancy in a new query
hydrogen production or sulfur reduction activity
minimal_role_compatibility.do_not_use: Do not reduce the rule to a generic Cys count or require all 18 comparison Cys positions; C191 and C343 are not deposited SF4 ligands in entity 2.
